newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan PM's brother gets confidence vote.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan PM's brother gets confidence vote.

text.p: The Punjab provincial assembly gave an overwhelming vote of confidence on Friday to new chief minister Shahbaz Sharif, brother of Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif.
The official APP news agency said 229 members of the 240-seat assembly had voted for Shahbaz, 46, who was sworn in as leader of the populous central province on Thursday.
Shahbaz held no formal office during his brother's first stint as prime minister from 1990 to 1993 but he wielded great influence in the central and Punjab provincial governments.
Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League (PML) will also lead provincial governments in the southern province of Sindh and North West Frontier province in coalition with allied parties.
The only province with a non-PML government will be Baluchistan in the southwest, where Balochi nationalist groups say they can form a majority bloc in the 43-member assembly.
